symptom: HTTP 500 spike to 42%, p99 latency jumped from 120ms to 7800ms during morning settlement batch
error_signature: ConnectionPoolTimeoutError: pool exhausted after 30000ms (max_connections=10, active=10, waiting=142)
root_cause: Database connection pool size was capped at default 10 connections, while batch settlement job spawned 32 concurrent worker threads holding transactions open.
fix_applied: Increased max pool size to 50, lowered connectionTimeout to 10000ms, and added circuit breaker tripping on 5 consecutive pool exhaustion timeouts.

symptom: Kubernetes Pod crash looping with exit code 137 (OOMKilled), restart count climbing every 45 minutes
error_signature: NodeOOMAlert: container auth-service killed by cgroup memory limit 512Mi (RSS reached 528MiB)
root_cause: JWT token revocation blacklist cache was implemented using an unbounded in-memory JavaScript Map without TTL or eviction, leaking 20MB/hour.
fix_applied: Replaced unbounded Map with Redis-backed token cache with 15-minute TTL, and added liveness probe checking heap limit.

symptom: CrashLoopBackOff immediately after deployment of release v2.4.1; 0 messages processed from SQS queue
error_signature: KeyError: 'RABBITMQ_AMQP_URL' not found in environment; Application failed to bootstrap within 30s
root_cause: Helm chart deployment config renamed 'RABBITMQ_URL' to 'RABBITMQ_AMQP_URL', but Kubernetes secret mapping was not updated in staging/prod manifests.
fix_applied: Updated Kubernetes ConfigMap secretKeyRef to expose RABBITMQ_AMQP_URL and added pre-start schema validation script.

symptom: Global 504 Gateway Timeout across all public web traffic; gateway CPU at 95% due to thousands of pending socket handles
error_signature: UpstreamTimeout: payments-api upstream connection timed out after 15000ms on route /v1/checkout/charge
root_cause: payments-api slowdown caused incoming requests to queue in Envoy gateway workers without deadline propagation or load shedding.
fix_applied: Configured Envoy downstream circuit breaker with max_pending_requests=200, reduced upstream request timeout to 3000ms, and enabled adaptive rate limiting.

symptom: Pod in Evicted status: 'The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage. Container audit-logger was using 19.8GiB'
error_signature: DiskFullError: [Errno 28] No space left on device: '/var/log/audit/transactions.log'
root_cause: logrotate cron daemon failed due to a missing semicolon in logrotate.d/audit config, causing audit logs to grow unchecked for 14 days.
fix_applied: Fixed syntax error in logrotate.d/audit config, enabled daily log rotation with gzip compression and maxsize 500M, and mounted logs to dedicated PVC.

symptom: Checkout service failing during flash sale, checkout latency spiking to 8.2s, 500 errors on POST /orders
error_signature: ConnectionPoolTimeoutError: pool exhausted after 30000ms in orders-db-pool (active=20, max=20)
root_cause: Order checkout flow holds connection open while synchronously awaiting inventory reservation call over HTTP.
fix_applied: Adapted fix from INC-0001: Scaled HikariCP pool to 60, moved inventory call outside DB transaction block, and added Resilience4j circuit breaker.

symptom: Worker pod killed by cgroup OOM after running continuous daily aggregation batch for 6 hours
error_signature: NodeOOMAlert: container analytics-worker killed by cgroup memory limit 1024Mi (exit code 137)
root_cause: Pandas DataFrame concatenation inside batch consumer loop accumulated unreclaimed memory chunks without calling garbage collection or batch chunking.
fix_applied: Adapted fix from INC-0002: Refactored batch loop to use chunked streaming (chunksize=5000), explicitly invoked gc.collect(), and added memory ceiling monitor.

symptom: Billing worker pods crash looping immediately after config deployment, unable to decrypt customer cards
error_signature: KeyError: 'STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET' environment variable missing; bootstrap failed
root_cause: Stripe API keys were updated in AWS Secrets Manager but secret key name was changed without syncing the Kubernetes ExternalSecret CRD.
fix_applied: Adapted fix from INC-0003: Corrected ExternalSecret mapping key, redeployed ExternalSecret CRD, and added startup sanity validator.

symptom: Warehouse shipping worker threads blocked; HTTP 504 propagating to frontend dispatch dashboard
error_signature: UpstreamTimeout: shipping-carrier-api upstream connection timed out after 20000ms on /v2/labels/generate
root_cause: External shipping partner carrier API experienced degraded performance, exhausting local worker pool waiting on HTTP responses.
fix_applied: Adapted fix from INC-0004: Added bulkhead pattern with dedicated thread pool for carrier API, reduced timeout to 4000ms, and enabled asynchronous queue retry.

symptom: Disk write failure on worker node; ephemeral storage exceeded limit 10GiB
error_signature: DiskFullError: [Errno 28] No space left on device: '/tmp/sync_chunks/dump_chunk_9942.csv'
root_cause: Data sync job wrote temporary CSV export chunks to /tmp without cleanup on error handling path.
fix_applied: Adapted fix from INC-0005: Added try-finally cleanup blocks ensuring temp files are deleted, added cron job to purge /tmp files older than 2 hours.

symptom: Recurrent 500 error spike during month-end billing cycle; latency > 6s
error_signature: ConnectionPoolTimeoutError: pool exhausted after 30000ms in payments-api
root_cause: Month-end billing triggered concurrent billing runs exceeding old pool settings.
fix_applied: Instantly applied known fix from INC-0001: Scaled DB pool to 50 and activated circuit breaker.

symptom: Auth pods crashing again under load with exit code 137 (OOMKilled)
error_signature: NodeOOMAlert: container auth-service killed by cgroup memory limit 512Mi
fix_applied: Instantly applied known fix from INC-0002: Restarted deployment, ensured Redis token cache eviction TTL is active.
